front.title: Performance Metrics Registry Update for RFC 6374 Delay Metrics

abstract.t: RFC 6374 defines one-way, two-way, and round-trip delay measurements for MPLS networks, including a loopback procedure for round-trip delay measurement. The IANA Performance Metrics registry includes Metric Type name elements for one-way and round-trip delay, but does not include one for two-way delay. This document requests that IANA add the Two-Way Delay name element and add RFC 6374 as a reference for the existing One-Way Delay and Round-Trip Delay name elements.
